$comment: PROJECT MODE (the top-level `project` key): the build is driven by .dss-project.json through Program::compileProject / `dsscp --project`, which is the ONLY driver entry point that expands a manifest's source globs and runs its preBuildScripts hooks. Exit 42 = 7+11+13+11, summed at RUNTIME through a non-inlined call over a file-scope array that the pre-build script wrote moments earlier; nothing in git contains that array. The spec/artifact/runOn entries below keep their usual job -- gating the run and naming the artifact -- but they do NOT drive the build: compileProject takes no targets argument, so each `spec` is a MIRROR of one of the project manifest's own targets and both runners fail loud if it names a target the project never builds.
$commentOptimizedArm: THE RELEASE ARM BELOW EXISTS BECAUSE THIS MANIFEST'S OWN TRIGGER FIRED. The comment previously here declined an arm on measured grounds -- integrated_tests/runner.cpp passed no `--config` and knew nothing of shipped pipelines, so an arm would have been exercised in ONE of the two corpus runners, breaking the both-runners rule inside the very manifest that demonstrates it -- and it named its own condition: *add the release arm the day the CLI runner grows `--config`*. 2026-08-17 is that day (D-TEST-INTEGRATED-RUNNER-HAS-NO-OPTIMIZATION-ARM-CONCEPT + D-TEST-INTEGRATED-RUNNER-IGNORES-THE-RELEASE-ARM-AND-STDOUT-PINS). MEASURED at both sites: `--config` is a GLOBAL CLI flag rather than a `--compile`-only one, so the CLI runner applies the arm to a `--project` build; and the in-process runner's pipeline override is Program state read by the delegated compileFiles/compileUnits, so it survives compileProject too. Both runners now see this arm. NOTE the honest limit: the feature under test is a DRIVER/build-lifecycle one whose observable does not depend on the optimizer, so this arm is not expected to discriminate an optimizer defect -- it is here so project mode is not a hole in the release surface, and so the ONE project-mode example is not the ONE example that skips it.
